$comment: MACHINE half of GET /catalog/opencode, GET /catalog/openrouter and of the normalised snapshots the two catalog legs keep in their store; the HUMAN half is catalog.md. GW-CATALOG-OR owns `openrouter_output`, `$defs.openrouter_snapshot` (the endpoint rows are openai-chat.schema.json $defs.endpoint_row), `$defs.catalog_block` and `$defs.canary_block` (the policy's two openrouter blocks), `$defs.cell_state`. Prices are $ per 1M tokens; a null cache rate = the vendor names none for that class. No error codes: the view answers 200, an absent snapshot is empty rows. A second rule, GW-MODEL-TIERS, owns $defs.benchmarks_snapshot (the committed tier-evidence snapshot, argocd/resources/agent-gateway/benchmarks.json) and $defs.tiers_block (the policy's derivation rules).

limit.description: the plan's monthly limit in USD, "unlimited", or null = the page has no row for the model under the plan

fetched_at.description: the last good snapshot's fetch time; null = none yet

last_outcome.description: null = no refresh attempted by this process yet

above_tokens.description: 0 = the base row; N = the vendor's `tier: {type: context, size: N}` row

score_axis.description: the three Artificial Analysis indices of a capability row

cell_state.description: a (model, provider) cell's ENTRY state (GW-CATALOG-OR): new to the snapshot or back from exclusion → candidate; one canary ride completed clean on exactly that cell → eligible (the only state selection pins); a canary struck → excluded, with the class, for canary.cooldown_s

ranking_slice.description: the MCP list-daily-model-rankings slices the catalog may read (period week): a category and a modality

catalog_block.$comment: the policy's `rails.openrouter.catalog` (GW-CATALOG-OR): the registry's SOURCES, never its candidates

account_ref.description: ns/name of the labelled Secret holding the openrouter ACCOUNT key the MCP reads ride (key OPENROUTER_API_KEY)

ranking_top_n.description: per slice, the top N of the latest week by tokens

canary_block.$comment: the policy's `rails.openrouter.canary` (GW-CATALOG-OR §The entry canary): who rides a canary and the cap — never code constants

harness.description: the harness the openrouter cells serve; a canary body may name another the rail speaks

max_per_refresh.description: canary admissions between two catalog refreshes

usd_per_day.description: metered canary spend over the trailing day, at the cell's endpoint price

cooldown_s.description: an excluded cell is a candidate again after this

openrouter_snapshot.$comment: the store's `catalog_snapshots.openrouter-endpoints` body as the catalog leg writes it (GW-CATALOG-OR) — openai-chat.schema.json $defs.endpoint_snapshot's `models` with the leg's provenance per model, plus `sources`

ranking.description: per slice the model ranked in, the latest week's tokens

ranked.description: distinct model ids across the slices' latest week

endpoint_failures.description: candidates whose endpoints could not be read this refresh (absent from it)

bands.description: a candidate is in a tier when its score >= band x the rail's top score; heavy >= standard >= light

cap.description: each tier list keeps this many, cheapest-first

cost.$comment: GW-MODEL-TIERS §Cost per clean ride: the terms the derivation orders by and the rail choice compares with — never code constants

ride_tokens_out_m.description: M output tokens one ride spends

strike_overhead_usd.description: what a failed ride costs on top of itself (the reviewer round + the coordinator re-entry); 0 = unmeasured

min_rides.description: judged rides before a cell's measured clean rate replaces its prior

price_basis.description: where a candidate row's price comes from: `endpoint` = the openrouter model's SELECTED endpoint; `promise` / `measured` = the Go plan's discount over the model's allowance / over the rail's trailing-30-day draw; `unlimited` = a Go model with no monthly limit (0); null = unpriced

prior.description: the clean-rate prior while judged < tiers.cost.min_rides: the selected endpoint's uptime_1d / 100 on openrouter, 1.0 on the Go rail

aa_id.description: the Artificial Analysis id the policy id joins (join_aa_id); null = unbenched

out_price.description: $ per 1M output tokens: the openrouter model's SELECTED endpoint's price (null until a cell passed the entry canary — never the headline), the Go model's list price x the plan's discount (GET /catalog/opencode pricing); null = unpriced (the subscription rail)

monthly_limit_usd.description: the Go plan's monthly limit; null on the other rails

provider.description: the openrouter model's selected provider slug (the cell the price and the rides belong to); null elsewhere

rides.description: the cell's clean-ride evidence from the gateway's outcome store at snapshot time

pulled_at.description: the newest updated_ts of the old proxy's capability table

rows.description: the capability table's row count (the snapshot keeps only the candidates)

fee_usd_month.description: pricing.fee_usd_month — the plan's monthly fee the Go prices divide

draw_30d_usd.description: pricing.draw_30d_usd — the rail's list-priced draw over the trailing 30 days at snapshot time

cells.description: the view's cells by entry state at snapshot time — how many openrouter prices could exist

rails.description: per rail, the CANDIDATE rows keyed by POLICY model id (the rail's spelling: claude/<alias>, opencode-go/<id>, a bare openrouter id)

config_snapshot.description: the config source's snapshot: the merged listing — models.dev's opencode-go rows (deprecated dropped) under the console's overrides (GW-CATALOG-GO, 2026-10-20)

plan_fees.description: the page's Plan table: each plan's monthly fee in USD (GW-MODEL-TIERS divides it)

openrouter_output.$comment: GET /catalog/openrouter — the OpenRouter catalog's read-only view (GW-CATALOG-OR): the snapshot with every cell's entry state, the provider the data plane would pin per model, the canary budget; no auth, no error codes (no snapshot = empty models)

sources.description: the snapshot's `sources` (empty before the first good refresh)

items.$comment: openai-chat.schema.json $defs.endpoint_row plus the cell's entry state, its rides and the floors' verdict (GW-CATALOG-OR): `pinnable` / `floor` are what `canary-entrants.sh` walks by — a candidate that is not pinnable for the ride's harness is skipped (homelab#2775)

class.description: the strike class that excluded the cell

rides.description: the cell's clean-ride evidence (GW-MODEL-TIERS: a ride = a session this provider served a 2xx to whose latest outcome is reported)

pinnable.description: per harness (the keys of the policy's `providers.tool_choice` — never a code list): whether this provider's representative endpoint clears the floors GW-RAIL-OPENROUTER §Selection pins by (quantization at or above the floor, every tool-choice mode the harness uses, uptime_1d at or above the floor — a null clears none, status 0), evaluated by the data plane's own predicate; `state` eligible AND pinnable[harness] true = selection can pin the cell; a provider's service tiers carry the representative's verdict; `{}` when the rail declares no providers policy (nothing is ever pinned)

floor.description: per harness that fails, the floor it fails (`quantization fp4 < fp8`, `no tool_choice required,function`, `uptime_1d unknown`, `uptime_1d 77.4 < 95`, `status 1`); `{}` when every harness passes

selected.description: the provider the data plane would pin first (GW-RAIL-OPENROUTER §Selection over the ELIGIBLE cells, the canary harness); null = none eligible — the model rides unpinned

plan.description: rails.opencode.plan; null = the policy has no opencode rail

plan_fee_usd_month.description: the docs snapshot's Plan table fee for `plan`; null = no docs snapshot carrying the table yet

pricing.$comment: GW-MODEL-TIERS §Cost per clean ride — the Go rail's price per model: list price x fee / max(the rail's trailing-30-day list-priced draw, the model's monthly limit)

draw_30d_usd.description: the opencode rail's metered 2xx requests over the trailing 30 days at the catalog's list rates (the window draw's pricing)

out.description: $ per 1M output tokens after the discount; null = unpriced (no fee, not in the catalog)

discount.description: fee / max(draw_30d_usd, the model's monthly limit); 0 for an unlimited model

listed.description: in the config snapshot (the account's listed set — not a liveness signal)

windows_usd.description: window_shares x the plan's monthly limit; null when the limit is not a number

policy_models.description: every opencode model the policy names (tiers + side_models), by wire id
